headline: Advancing Quantum States, Metrology, and Gate Operations
summary: Today's research explores foundational quantum information theory, demonstrating efficient learning algorithms for complex tensor networks, analyzing disorder-induced precision enhancements in topological systems, and bounding gate-cutting costs via nonlocality measures.

themes.title: Tensor Network Learning
themes.body: We introduce polynomial-time algorithms for proper agnostic learning of matrix product states and tree tensor networks, using improper learning and a novel comparator-dual compression procedure.

themes.title: Topological Metrology and Nonlocality
themes.body: Recent work examines how disorder enhances quantum Fisher information in toric codes and establishes sharp envelopes linking quasiprobability extent to nonlocality descriptors for optimal gate-cutting.

connections.body: Both studies advance fundamental quantum resource characterization, analyzing operator-level properties such as entanglement-based tensor network compression and quasiprobability-based gate costs.
